title: Santee Lab HVAC Replacement
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF > FOREST SERVICE > USDA  FOREST SERVICE
description:
Solicitation number 1240BE27Q0018 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for the replacement of an existing 3-ton packaged heat pump system with a new, high efficiency ENERGY STAR certified unit that also satisfies FEMP federal purchasing requirements for energy consuming products. The unit serves the Laboratory at the Santee Experimental Forest located at 3734 SC-402, Cordesville, SC 29434. 

 Please see attached solicitation and supporting documents for a full description of the requirement.
